# Craigslist Los Angeles

> > Local classifieds and community marketplace for Los Angeles, connecting residents with jobs, housing, services, and community events across the greater LA metropolitan area.

Craigslist Los Angeles serves the diverse communities of the LA region, including the San Fernando Valley and Long Beach, providing a platform for local buying, selling, hiring, and community connection. Founded by Craig Newmark, the site continues its mission of supporting local communities through Craigslist Charitable and Craig Newmark Philanthropies.

## Key Topics

- Los Angeles classifieds
- Local marketplace
- Job listings
- Apartment rentals
- Housing search
- Community events
- San Fernando Valley
- Long Beach
- Craig Newmark Philanthropies
- Craigslist Charitable
- For sale listings
- Services directory
- Community board
- Local services

## Main Hub

- [Los Angeles Homepage](https://losangeles.craigslist.org/): Main Los Angeles craigslist homepage with jobs, housing, and local classifieds

## Regional Communities

- [San Fernando Valley](https://losangeles.craigslist.org/sfv/): SF Valley regional page for local classifieds and community listings
- [Long Beach](https://losangeles.craigslist.org/lgb/): Long Beach regional page for jobs, housing, and local marketplace
